about: Land-class / coverage layers (Natura 2000, SAC/SPA, SSSI, Schutzgebiete, CDDA, designated areas, parcel-named DNR layers ...) that chat 11 answered YES and Brandon approved for wiring on Nov 7 2026 7:06 PM CST: 'If you all approved the layers send them in...no use holding a bunch of stuff unless they a real problem'. kpc_key_layers.py wires a LANDCLASS-matching YES row ONLY when its URL is listed under 'approved' here; any other land-class row still waits for Brandon's word. held.title: Nationally designated areas (NatDA) -polygons small scale vi
held.why_held: EEA Europe-wide layer (all EU countries in one). The world key already reads EEA Natura 2000 and CDDA for every EU country WITH its own country filter (kpc_world_key.py); extra-layers.json rows carry no filter, so this would read all of Europe again for one country (and break the Nov 7 B6 rule: one Natura 2000 source per country). Held Nov 7 2026 in review.
